## Purpose and Entry Points
PersonaLive is a PyTorch diffusion system for real-time, streamable portrait animation: a reference image is animated by motion from a driving video or webcam. Batch and live entry points are `inference_offline.py` and `inference_online.py`; the latter serves a browser UI at port 7860. Training is explicitly staged through `train_stage1.py`, `train_stage2.py`, and `train_stage3.py`.

## Inference Orchestration
Offline inference consumes a reference image plus driving video, with optional long-video streaming generation and xFormers attention. Live inference selects normal, xFormers, or TensorRT execution. Configuration separates stage 1/2 inference from stage 3 temporal streaming:
- `inference_offline.py`
- `inference_online.py`
- `configs/inference/inference_stage1&2.yaml`
- `configs/inference/inference_stage3.yaml`

## Animation Pipeline
The central boundary is motion extraction versus diffusion synthesis. LivePortrait-derived components derive facial motion/camera signals from driving frames; pose conditioning and motion features then drive reference-conditioned image/video diffusion pipelines.
- `src/liveportrait/motion_extractor.py`
- `src/models/pose_guider.py`
- `src/pipelines/pipeline_pose2img.py`
- `src/pipelines/pipeline_pose2vid.py`

## Diffusion and Temporal Model Stack
Reference appearance is represented through a reference UNet/attention path, while denoising uses customized 2D/3D UNets. The video path adds temporal modules and explicit reference handling to preserve identity and continuity over generated frame windows. DDIM controls the iterative denoising schedule.
- `src/models/unet_2d_condition.py`
- `src/models/unet_3d_explicit_reference.py`
- `src/models/motion_module.py`
- `src/scheduler/scheduler_ddim.py`

## Runtime Wrappers and Acceleration
The wrapper layer packages model loading and inference execution. Standard execution is CUDA/PyTorch; ONNX export and TensorRT provide an optimized UNet path, with a locally built engine expected for hardware compatibility. Pretrained PersonaLive, Stable Diffusion VAE/image-variation, ONNX, and TensorRT artifacts are external runtime inputs under `pretrained_weights/`.
- `src/wrapper.py`
- `src/wrapper_trt.py`
- `src/modeling/onnx_export.py`
- `torch2trt.py`

## Live Streaming Interface
The online path bridges webcam/video capture, frame-by-frame animation, and browser transport. Python live-video workers have standard and TensorRT variants; a Svelte frontend supplies image/video inputs, controls, logging, and rendered-frame playback. This is a local streaming application rather than a hosted backend integration.
- `webcam/vid2vid.py`
- `webcam/vid2vid_trt.py`
- `webcam/connection_manager.py`
- `webcam/frontend/src/routes/+page.svelte`

## Training and Data Flow
Training progresses from image-level warm-up, to adversarial image refinement using StyleGAN2 discrimination, to temporal-module fine-tuning for streamable video. Video datasets require aligned face/eye/mouth box artifacts; portrait dataset loaders and augmentation feed stage-specific configs. Stages consume predecessor checkpoints, making checkpoint paths the handoff boundary.
- `train_stage1.py`
- `train_stage2.py`
- `train_stage3.py`
- `src/dataset/portrait_video.py`
- `src/stylegan2/discriminator.py`
- `configs/train/personalive_stage3.yaml`
